title: twist-product
description: The pre-bilattice L1 ⋈ L2 built on the product carrier L1 × L2, where the first coordinate tracks positive evidence and the second negative evidence; the truth order raises positive and lowers negative while the knowledge order raises both. It is the pre-bilattice generated by twisting two lattices together.

left.description: the first factor lattice L1 with meet, join and order, supplying the positive-evidence coordinate

right.description: the second factor lattice L2 with meet, join and order, supplying the negative-evidence coordinate

carrier.description: the carrier is the product set L1 × L2 of pairs <a1, a2>

twistMeetTruth.description: <a1,a2> ∧t <b1,b2> = <a1 ⊓_1 b1, a2 ⊔_2 b2>: truth meet takes L1-meet on the positive coordinate and L2-join on the negative

twistOrderTruth.description: <a1,a2> ≤t <b1,b2> iff a1 ≤_1 b1 and b2 ≤_2 a2: the truth order raises positive evidence and lowers negative

twistOrderKnowledge.description: <a1,a2> ≤k <b1,b2> iff a1 ≤_1 b1 and a2 ≤_2 b2: the knowledge order raises both coordinates
